verbose.description: Enable verbose output in tractor CLI commands.

proxy_port.description: The local port where the Tor SOCKS proxy listens for the user session.

startup_actions.description: List of tractor commands to execute on startup. Items should be strings like 'set' or 'unset'. Note: Tractor itself is stateless per session, this is for wrapper scripts or future extensibility.

identity_rotation_interval.description: Automatic identity rotation interval in seconds. 0 disables auto-rotation.
